title: Pre-Send Lead List Checker: DMARC, SPF & MX input
description: Paste the prospect or client domains, then click Start. URLs and email addresses are turned into domains automatically. Each domain is looked up in public DNS only: the Actor never sends email and needs no API keys.

domains.title: Domains, URLs or emails
domains.description: Required. The prospect or client domains to check, one per line. Accepts bare domains (acme-example.com), website URLs (https://www.acme-example.com/contact) and email addresses (jane@acme-example.com); the domain is extracted from each. Paste one spreadsheet or CSV column at a time (use Bulk edit in Console). Duplicates are removed and entries that are not valid domains are skipped. At most "Max domains per run" are checked.

dkimSelectors.sectionDescription: Leave these at the defaults for a first run. Add selectors only if a domain uses a custom DKIM selector.
dkimSelectors.title: DKIM selectors to test
dkimSelectors.description: Optional. DKIM selectors to look up as <selector>._domainkey.<domain>, one per line (letters, digits, hyphens). A selector counts as found when its TXT record, or the CNAME target, holds a non-empty p= key. The default is a list of 17 common selectors (google, selector1, selector2, k1, s1, sendgrid and others). Add your provider's selector if a known domain shows no DKIM key. If you clear the list, the Actor falls back to google, selector1, selector2 and default.

includeRecords.title: Include A/AAAA/CAA records
includeRecords.description: Optional. When on (default), each row also includes the IPv4 (a) and IPv6 (aaaa) addresses and the CAA records. Turn off to skip those three lookups per domain; the email-auth fields and score are not affected.

concurrency.sectionDescription: Safety caps for large lists. You can leave these unchanged.
concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Optional. How many domains are looked up in parallel. Whole number from 1 to 30, default 10. Higher values finish large lists sooner.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Optional safety cap. Whole number from 1 to 100000, default 10000. If the list has more valid, unique domains, only the first N are checked.
